title: Deployable artifact manifest
description: The manifest at the root of one versioned cut under deployable-artifacts/. Minimal on purpose: this is a scaffold for a packaging step that does not exist yet (port Phase 6), and a schema that guesses at fields nobody writes is a schema that gets ignored on first contact.

version.description: The cut's version. Also the name of the folder holding it, so a manifest and its directory cannot disagree.

source_commit.description: The full 40-character git SHA the cut was made from. Full, not abbreviated: an abbreviation is a prefix that stops being unique as the repo grows.

created.description: When the cut was made, RFC 3339 with an offset.

files.description: Every file in the cut, each with its hash. The list is the cut: a file present on disk but absent here is not part of it.

path.description: Path relative to the cut's own folder. Never absolute, never escaping the folder with '..'.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex.

mode.description: Optional POSIX mode, octal. Present only where it matters — a hook or script written 0644 fails with exit 126 wherever it is registered (I-0060).

note.description: Optional one-line reason this cut exists. Not a changelog.
